Booking.metaDescription: Ohereza ubusabe bw'urugendo kuri ELVAIS i Kigali. Azaguhamagara kugira ngo mwemeranye ku bisobanuro n'igiciro.
Booking.title: Saba <accent>urugendo</accent>
Booking.intro: Bwira ELVAIS iby'urugendo rwawe. Azaguhamagara cyangwa akakwandikira kuri WhatsApp kugira ngo mwemeranye ku bisobanuro n'igiciro.

phone.label: Numero ya telefoni
phone.hint: Numero z'u Rwanda wazandika nka 078 123 4567. Uri hanze y'igihugu, tangira na + n'kode y'igihugu cyawe.

email.label: Imeri
email.hint: Niba ushaka ubutumwa bwemeza kuri imeri gusa.

notes.label: Icyo wongeraho
notes.hint: Urugero imizigo, intebe y'umwana cyangwa nimero y'indege.

Booking.notice: ELVAIS azaguhamagara kugira ngo mwemeranye ku bisobanuro n'igiciro. Nta kwishyura kuri interineti bikenewe.
Booking.crossBorder: Ingendo zinyura hanze y'u Rwanda ntizitangwa. Ingendo zigomba kuguma mu Rwanda.
Booking.summaryTitle: Nyamuneka ukosore ibi bikurikira kugira ngo ukomeze

errors.pastDateTime: Iyi tariki n'iyi saha byarenze. Hitamo igihe kizaza.
errors.tooFar: Hitamo itariki iri mu mwaka utaha.
errors.passengersRange: Andika umubare kuva kuri 1 kugeza kuri {max}.
errors.daysRange: Andika iminsi kuva kuri {minDays} kugeza kuri {maxDays}.
errors.formExpired: Iyi fomu yararangiye. Ibyo wanditse biracyahari, ongera ubwohereze.
errors.tryAgain: Hari ikitagenze neza. Ongera ugerageze kohereza.
errors.rateLimited: Ubusabe ni bwinshi cyane buturutse kuri interineti yawe. Tegereza iminota mike, cyangwa uhamagare ELVAIS ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa umwandikire kuri WhatsApp.
errors.serverError: Ntitwabashije kubika ubusabe bwawe. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa uhamagare ELVAIS cyangwa umwandikire kuri WhatsApp.

Received.title: Ubusabe <accent>bwakiriwe</accent>
Received.lead: Murakoze. Ubusabe bwawe bw'urugendo bwoherejwe kuri ELVAIS.
Received.keepCode: Bika iyi kode igihe ukeneye kuvuga ubusabe bwawe.
Received.contactText: ELVAIS azaguhamagara cyangwa akakwandikira kuri WhatsApp kugira ngo mwemeranye ku bisobanuro n'igiciro.
Received.whatsappPrefill: Muraho ELVAIS, kode y'ubusabe bwanjye ni {ref}.
